scope: Capabilities observably demonstrated in the frozen 36.866667-second recording. This denominator does not claim universal parity with undisclosed source-product behavior.
closure_rule: Every required capability must be IMPLEMENTED and certification PASS for one exact Mucaro source SHA, with positive and negative execution evidence and zero unresolved residue inside this denominator.

capabilities.observed_behavior: A durable interactive agent session remains active while work proceeds and state changes are rendered in the terminal.
The agent inspects repository/workspace state as part of the active coding workflow.
The agent reads project files during task execution.
The agent edits project source during an execution run.
Repository changes can be inspected as diffs during the coding workflow.
The agent executes commands from the coding session instead of only generating instructions.
The agent can pause for an operator choice and continue the same run after the answer.
A plan can be prepared and reviewed without executing its actions.
The operator can execute the plan interactively with pauses at permission or decision boundaries.
The operator can choose an autonomous execution mode that continues across plan steps.
The plan is represented as live task/todo state whose dependencies and progress change during execution.
Tool/action execution can stop at an explicit operator approval boundary.
The operator can authorize a bounded execution scope for the active run rather than approving every action individually.
An active execution can be interrupted from the terminal without destroying session state.
Interrupted or paused work can resume with prior progress preserved.
Saved sessions are accessible from a terminal-native Sessions surface.
The terminal exposes a dedicated Current view for the active agent run.
GitHub issues are accessible from the terminal agent surface.
Pull requests are accessible from the terminal agent surface.
Gists are accessible from the terminal agent surface.
The coding agent can create or use branches and create commits under explicit authority.
The agent can execute applicable tests/regression gates and use their results during the run.
The agent can inspect CI/check status as part of the repository workflow.
The agent can open or update a pull request where authorized.
The active model and execution mode are visible in the terminal session.
The terminal exposes live context or token-usage status for the active session.
The capabilities are integrated into one persistent full-screen terminal user interface rather than isolated one-shot subcommands.
